regulation.name: CERT-In Directions under Section 70B(6) of IT Act, 2000

requirements.title: Mandatory 180-Day System & Access Log Retention within Indian Jurisdiction
requirements.requirement_text: All service providers, intermediaries, data centers, body corporate and Government organizations shall enable and securely maintain logs of all their ICT systems for a rolling period of 180 consecutive days within the Indian jurisdiction.

requirements.title: Mandatory Time Synchronization with National Physical Laboratory (NPL) NTP
requirements.requirement_text: All service providers and intermediaries shall connect to the Network Time Protocol (NTP) Server of National Physical Laboratory (NPL) or National Informatics Centre (NIC) to synchronize all system clocks across cloud infrastructure.

requirements.title: Cyber Security Incident Telemetry & 6-Hour Reporting Readiness
requirements.requirement_text: Cloud service providers must maintain real-time telemetry, alarm logging, and multi-region CloudTrail audit logging ready to furnish cybersecurity incident logs within 6 hours of incident notice.
